sources.title: omaru_polka_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume of [[hololive]]'s [[Omaru Polka]].

It consists of a [[tilted headwear|tilted]] [[jester cap]], [[x hair ornament|x-shaped]] [[hairclip]]s each one with a different card suit ornament at the end, a [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[halter shirt]] with playing suit-themed [[bow button|bow]] [[buttons]] and a [[navel cutout]], a [[detached collar|detached]] [[wing collar]] with a [[red bowtie|red]] [[traditional bowtie]], a puffed [[vertical-striped skirt|vertical-stripped]] [[blue skirt|blue]] and white [[layered skirt|layered]] [[miniskirt]] with a [[large bow|large]] [[skirt bow|bow]] [[back bow|on the back]], [[mismatched legwear|mismatched]] and [[uneven legwear|asymmetrical]] [[vertical-striped thighhighs|vertical striped]] [[cross-laced legwear|cross-laced]] [[blue thighhighs|blue]] and [[pink thighhighs]] and [[mismatched footwear|mismatched]] [[red shoes|red]] [[pointy shoes]]. She also wears a [[single glove|single]] [[single elbow glove|elbow glove]] [[cross-laced gloves|cross-laced]] [[multicolored gloves|multi-colored]] [[black gloves|black]] and [[red gloves|red]] elbow glove in one arm and an [[arm strap]] and a [[wrist cuffs|wrist cuff]] in the other.

h4. Appearance

* !post #4332653: Reference sheet (1)
* !post #4332668: Reference sheet (2)
